sys_script_include.description:
Handles safety stock consumption and replenishment.
When a fulfillment decision consumes safety stock (LOCAL_SAFETY_STOCK), this engine: 1. Records the consumed quantity 2. Creates a replenishment inventory request (safety_stock_replenishment) 3. Creates a safety stock consumption alert 4. Prevents duplicate requests for the same decision
Does NOT modify the configured safety_stock threshold. Does NOT auto-approve procurement. Does NOT modify inventory quantities directly.
sys_script_include.name: SafetyStockReplenishment
